summary_en: Update to capital-cost and stock-price focused management framework following completion of 'Next Stage Execution Plan 2023' (May 2023–Apr 2026). Revised targets and initiatives disclosed in conjunction with new 'Next Stage Execution Plan 2026' effective May 2026.
title_en: Update on Management Initiatives to Achieve Capital-Cost and Stock-Price Conscious Management
translation_en_brief: On 27 July 2026, AZEARTH Corporation announced an update to its framework for management focused on capital cost and stock price. The company completed its 'Next Stage Execution Plan 2023' covering May 2023 through April 2026 and has begun a new medium-term plan period from May 2026 onwards. This disclosure updates the capital-cost and stock-price conscious management initiatives originally announced on 10 July 2024, incorporating an assessment of results from the prior plan and alignment with the new medium-term strategy. Specific metrics and targets are detailed in the attached materials, which were filed concurrently with the 'Next Stage Execution Plan 2026' on the same date. The update reflects the company's ongoing commitment to disciplined capital allocation and shareholder value.
